testimonials.name: Ali Wilson
testimonials.text: The crew was professional, prompt, clean and skilled. We are so happy we went with Quality Roof Express and will be calling for other jobs in the future!! Thank you for putting a new roof over our heads!

testimonials.name: Carolene
testimonials.text: They were quick to get me an estimate, and kept in contact with me throughout the process. On time with great quality work and customer service. Definitely recommend.

testimonials.name: Barb
testimonials.text: I highly recommend Quality Roofing Express for anyone in need of a new roof. Osman and his crew did an excellent job. They all work together so well. Roof was done so quickly, the price was great and clean up was unbelievable, you would not have even known they were here. Thank you for a great job

testimonials.name: Tom Belinsky
testimonials.text: I have personally had Osman and his team do three roofs for me and they are currently working on a roof for my son. From the moment I met Osman 5 years ago to the present, he has been the consummate professional. The quality of work and the attention to detail are second to none. He personally manages every job.

testimonials.name: Michael Stout
testimonials.text: Replaced existing roof. Very pleasant to work with and did good work. Update: roof still holding up well.

testimonials.name: Lawrence Rosetti
testimonials.text: The work on my roof was professionally done in a timely fashion. The workers were great and cleaned up nicely after completing the job.

testimonials.name: Tayla Clements
testimonials.text: Fast response times, excellent work, and great job cleaning up afterwards. Very satisfied customer.

testimonials.name: Lisa Conley
testimonials.text: Such a great company!! Very professional. We couldn't be happier. Just had them do another part of our roof and once again they were awesome!

testimonials.name: jeffrey cerato
testimonials.text: My new roof looks great. Very fair price and excellent workmanship. Friendly staff. My new roof was on in one day. Highly recommend.

about_story: We are an Independent Family Owned business, stemming from a small local town, connecting with our community and surrounding areas to provide QUALITY work. We take pride in treating each home as if it was our own. As homeowners ourselves we know the importance of protecting our homes from any weather damage. Memories made in a Home is a treasure we vow to protect with you.
